operation_descriptions.SET_UNION: We take the union of {left_name} and {right_name}, calling the result {node_name}.
operation_descriptions.SET_INTERSECTION: We take the intersection of {left_name} and {right_name}, calling the result {node_name}.
operation_descriptions.SET_DIFFERENCE: Starting from {left_name}, we remove elements of {right_name} to get {node_name}.
operation_descriptions.BAG_UNION: We merge {left_name} and {right_name} by adding their quantities to obtain {node_name}.
operation_descriptions.BAG_INTERSECTION: We combine {left_name} and {right_name} by taking the minimum quantity of each element to get {node_name}.
operation_descriptions.BAG_DIFFERENCE: Starting from {left_name}, we subtract the quantities in {right_name} to get {node_name}, ensuring no element's quantity becomes negative.
operation_descriptions.CHOOSE: From {source_name}, we select {k} elements without replacement to form {node_name}.
operation_descriptions.CHOOSE_REPLACE: From {source_name}, we repeatedly select {k} elements (with replacement) to form {node_name}.
operation_descriptions.CHOOSE_TUPLE: From {source_name}, we pick {k} elements and arrange them in order to form {node_name}.
operation_descriptions.CHOOSE_REPLACE_TUPLE: We draw {k} elements from {source_name} (with replacement) and arrange them in {node_name}.
operation_descriptions.CHOOSE_REPLACE_SEQUENCE: We draw {k} elements from {source_name} with replacement and arrange them in sequence {node_name}.
operation_descriptions.SEQUENCE: We arrange all elements from {source_name} to form an ordered sequence {node_name}.
operation_descriptions.CIRCLE: We arrange all elements from {source_name} around a circle called {node_name}{reflection}
operation_descriptions.COMPOSE: We divide {source_name} into {k} groups(allowing empty groups and groups are labeled), storing the result in {node_name}.
operation_descriptions.PARTITION: We split {source_name} into {k} groups (allowing empty groups and groups are not labeled), storing the result in {node_name}.
operation_descriptions.BAG_CHOOSE: From {source_name}, we select {k} elements to form a sub-multiset {node_name}.
operation_descriptions.BAG_CHOOSE_REPLACE: From {source_name}, we select exactly {k} elements in total, with replacement, to form {node_name}.
operation_descriptions.BAG_COMPOSE: We partition {source_name} into {k} non-empty sub-multisets {node_name}(allowing empty sub-multisets and sub-multisets are labeled).
operation_descriptions.BAG_PARTITION: We split {source_name} into {k} sub-multisets {node_name}(allowing empty sub-multisets and sub-multisets are not labeled).
operation_descriptions.BAG_SUPPORT: Taking {source_name}, we extract its distinct elements to form a set {node_name}.
operation_descriptions.TUPLE: We convert {source_name} into an ordered sequence {node_name}.

constraint_descriptions.BagChooseSizeConstraint: The total number of elements in {bag_choose} must be {comparator} {param}.
constraint_descriptions.ComposeSizeConstraint: The size of the {index}th subset must be {comparator} {param}.
constraint_descriptions.BagComposeCountSizeConstraint: The number of {entity} in the {index}th subset must be {param}.

PredecessorConstraint.positive: Sequence {target} must contain {entity1} and {entity2} such that {entity1} is immediately before {entity2}.
PredecessorConstraint.negative: Sequence {target} does not have {entity1} immediately before {entity2} if both are present.

LessThanConstraint.positive: Sequence {target} must contain {entity1} and {entity2} such that {entity1} comes before {entity2} (not necessarily immediately).
LessThanConstraint.negative: Sequence {target} does not have {entity1} before {entity2} (immediately or not) if both are present.

NextToConstraint.positive: Sequence {target} must contain {entity1} and {entity2} such that they are adjacent.
NextToConstraint.negative: Sequence {target} does not have {entity1} and {entity2} adjacent if both are present.

TogetherConstraint.positive: Entities ({group}) must be together in sequence {target} if any are present.
TogetherConstraint.negative: Sequence {target} contains the entities ({group}) and they are not together.

PredecessorBagConstraint.positive: There is a pair of {entity1} and {entity2} in sequence {target} such that {entity1} is immediately before {entity2}.
PredecessorBagConstraint.negative: Sequence {target} does not have any {entity1} immediately before any {entity2} ({target} that contain only {entity1} or only {entity2} or none of them are also allowed).

LessThanBagConstraint.positive: There is a pair of {entity1} and {entity2} in sequence {target} such that {entity1} comes before {entity2} (not necessarily immediately).
LessThanBagConstraint.negative: Sequence {target} does not have any {entity1} before any {entity2} (immediately or not) ({target} that contain only {entity1} or only {entity2} or none of them are also allowed).

NextToBagConstraint.positive: There is a pair of {entity1} and {entity2} in sequence {target} such that they are adjacent.
NextToBagConstraint.negative: Sequence {target} does not have any {entity1} and {entity2} adjacent ({target} that contain only {entity1} or only {entity2} or none of them are also allowed).

count_type.next_to: {entity1} and {entity2} are adjacent (in any order) {comparator} {value} times

constraint_descriptions.IndexMemberConstraint: The set at index {index} of {target} {positive} belong to {container}.
constraint_descriptions.TupleIndexMembershipConstraint: The element at position {index} of {target} must {positive}be {entity}.
constraint_descriptions.TupleAllMembersInConstraint: All elements in {target} must belong to {target_set}.
constraint_descriptions.TupleCountSizeConstraint: The number of {count_obj} in {target} must be {comparator} {param}.
constraint_descriptions.TupleDedupCountSizeConstraint: In {target}, the number of distinct elements belonging to {count_obj} must be {comparator} {param}.
constraint_descriptions.CountConstraint: The element {entity} must appear {comparator} {value} times in {target}.
constraint_descriptions.LinearCardinalityConstraint: The total size of {left} and {right} must be {comparator} {value}.
constraint_descriptions.QuantifiedConstraint: For each group in the {target}, the number of entities it contains must {comparator} {value}.
constraint_descriptions.IndexEqualMemberConstraint: The element at index {index} of {target} {positive} be {entity}.
